  "title": "Competitive Benchmarking",
  "phase": "Diagnose",
  "summary": "Comparative analysis of Northstar Retail Group against key omnichannel and digital-native competitors to identify operational and technological gaps.",
  "narrative": [
    "Northstar's current application estate is characterized by fragmented systems and slow release cycles, creating a competitive disadvantage against leaders in omnichannel fulfillment and digital experimentation.",
    "Benchmarking against Walmart, Target, and Amazon reveals critical gaps in fulfillment automation, loyalty-driven service integration, and release velocity.",
    "Closing these gaps requires a shift from legacy-heavy maintenance to a modernized, cloud-native operating model that supports real-time inventory and high-frequency deployment."
